name: cities
title: Pocket Goes to Town
brief: A travel series for small children. Pocket is a plush toy rabbit who rides in a child's backpack on family trips. Each book is one day in one city: arriving in the morning, then the famous places and the gentle local things a child would notice (animals, food, boats, trains, parks, weather), with the light changing from morning to night, and ending with Pocket asleep in the hotel room with the city lights twinkling outside. The child who owns Pocket is never shown; Pocket is on its own in every picture, perched on railings, benches, seats and windowsills, looking at things. Real, recognisable landmarks drawn simply. Everything is friendly and calm; the city is a kind place. The books share a title pattern and a refrain pattern so they feel like one set.
character: Pocket, a small, well-loved plush toy rabbit: pale lilac-grey fur, long floppy ears with one ear always bent over, round black button eyes, a stitched pink nose, a cream tummy patch and a little red neckerchief, slightly squashed from being hugged.
style: Children's picture-book illustration for ages 3 to 6 in the look of modern flat 2D television animation for preschoolers: bold, simple, rounded shapes with no outlines, flat colour fills with at most one soft shadow tone per shape, a bright but gentle palette of five main colours plus cream, warm sunny light, clean simple backgrounds with one or two big recognisable landmarks drawn as simple blocks of colour, lots of open space, no gradients, no texture, no photorealism. The toy rabbit is small and cute with big simple button eyes. Dark colours only in small accents, never large dark areas. Warm, calm, happy mood. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in the image.

books.hint: San Francisco: the Golden Gate Bridge in morning fog, cable cars on steep streets, sea lions at the pier, painted ladies houses, sourdough bread, the bay with sailboats, fog rolling in at night
Seattle: the Space Needle, Pike Place Market with fish and flowers, ferries on Puget Sound, rain and umbrellas, a coffee cup, Mount Rainier in the distance, orcas, a monorail

Brisbane: the river with CityCat ferries, the Story Bridge, the South Bank lagoon beach, purple jacaranda trees, a koala and kangaroos at a sanctuary, white ibis birds, Queenslander houses on stilts, a warm evening

Seoul: Gyeongbokgung palace with guards in colourful robes, children in hanbok, N Seoul Tower on the hill, the Han River, cherry blossom, hanok houses in Bukchon, tteokbokki and street food, the subway

New York: yellow taxis, Central Park with a carousel, the Statue of Liberty from a ferry, the Brooklyn Bridge, a pretzel cart, the subway, pigeons, the Empire State Building, skyscrapers lit up at night
